text:
Stanford University was founded in 1885 by Leland and Jane Stanford. It opened in 1891 on the Stanfords' former Palo Alto farm, initially modeled after Eastern universities like Cornell. The founders aimed for an institution that was non-sectarian and inclusive of both men and women. The Stanfords mandated that the campus buildings reflect local California heritage while emulating English university styles.
The university has a strong reputation for innovation; Frederick Terman encouraged engineering graduates to start companies, leading to the establishment of Stanford Industrial Park in the 1950s. Notable alumni include co-founders of Hewlett-Packard and Sun Microsystems, and prominent figures such as Steve Wozniak and Larry Page. Stanford is a private, non-profit institution governed by a board of trustees and is recognized globally for its high academic standing.
